Find the collapsed order temple in the Guhmension and step through the portal: The Chonkdom, an adventure world all of its own.

Become a recruit of &dthe Snuggle Order&r, pick a class and cheer up everything that has turned gray and grumpy. The quests check themselves off as soon as you hand them in inside the Chonkdom. Nothing is locked: every quest checks itself off as soon as you've done it, even if you did it earlier. The headings show what logically comes next. Check this off and get going, nice and chonky!
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_aanwijzingen_alle: Find all &e5 strange clues&r in the realm. Where do they lead?
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_binnen.desc: Find the collapsed order temple in the Guhmension and step through the sleeping portal. You arrive at &dCamp Snuggle&r, the training island of &dthe Snuggle Order&r. Your own stuff stays safe at home.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_binnen.title: The Chonkdom
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_geheim_spion.desc: Something's not right in Shroomsbury. All over the realm lie strange clues: black fluff, paw prints, a torn disguise... Find all five. Then you'll know who the traitor is, and you can unmask him. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_geheim_spion.task: Who Is Akim the Cheese Guh?
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_geheim_spion.titl: Who Is Akim the Cheese Guh?
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_hq01_welkom.desc: You've arrived by airship at Camp Snuggle, the training island of the Snuggle Order. Sergeant Fluffball sends you to the campfire on the square, where Cook Crispycrust is waiting for you. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_hq01_welkom.title: Welcome, Recruit!
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_hq02_pad.desc: At the little class temple you choose your first path: Snuggle Knight (up close, sturdy), Fluff Hunter (from afar, fast) or Chonk Mage (elements and healing). Later you can always switch at the order temple in Shroomsbury. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_hq02_pad.title: Choose Your Path
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_hq03_poppen.desc: The training field is full of straw training dummies. Bash them with your left mouse button (your normal attack). Also try your skills on R, V and G, and charge up your ultimate skill on Z. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_hq03_poppen.title: Dummy Bashing
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_hq03b_elementen.d: Grandpa Stardust teaches you the element triangle: Fire beats Shroom, Shroom beats Slime, and Slime beats Fire. A strong attack does x1.5 and you see 'Weak!'; the other way around it only does x0.7. Pink is strong against everything that has been dechonked. The little letter or icon next to a creature's health bar tells you its element. Answer his question! &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_hq04_kampvuur.des: Campfires are your checkpoints: light one with right-click and that's where you wake up if you faint. Light the campfire on the square and sit with the cook for a bit. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
A big dragon flew over the camp and dropped a clump of black fluff into the pond. Out came an enormous gray blob! Cheer it up. Watch its shadow: that's where it lands. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_hq06_zwamzoet.des: Captain Cloudwhistle flies you by airship to Shroomsbury, the mushroom town. The Grandmaster is waiting in the temple of the Snuggle Order, all the way on top of the tallest shroom. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_hq07_littekens.de: Investigate the gray scar in the Blob Meadow, east of Shroomsbury. Cheer up the blobs that turned grumpy from it and collect some gray fluff for research. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_hq08_sporenwoud.d: The second scar runs through the Sporewood, west of town. Ranger Moss keeps watch there by the first campfire. Cheer up the shrooms along the way. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_hq09_druipgrotten: Miner Giggles works in the Drip Caves to the northwest. He may have seen the shadowy figures. Find him deep in the caves and bring him safely to the cave campfire. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_hq10_zwamtempel.d: The figures went to the Shroom Temple, high up the mountain to the northeast. Cross the Gorge by the dragon fossil bridge and report to Temple Guard Stalky at the big door. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_hq11_opperzwam.de: Right-click the big door of the Shroom Temple: it slides open. Go inside, cheer up the temple shrooms and help the Overshroom. Watch out for his spore clouds, and when the temple goes dark: light the lightshrooms! &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_hq12_schaduw.desc: Bring the Mika pin to Grandmaster Chonkfoot in the order temple of Shroomsbury. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_k01_dobber.desc: Fisher Bobber has lost his little hat. It blew off toward the lighthouse. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_k01_dobber.title: Bobber's Little Hat
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_k02_uitzicht.desc: Miss Dart thinks every hunter should see the view from the lighthouse first. From there you can see Shroomsbury. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_knuffels_alle.des: Find all &e10 lost plushies&r of Little Kiki. They glitter with little hearts.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_rijdier_hoedhuppe: Stable Master Hoofy helps you get your first mount: a Cloud Lamb. Find the Lamb Pasture in the Blob Meadow and collect root shrooms to lure one over. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
A Cloud Lamb of Your Own
A Cloud Lamb of Your Own
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_rijdier_knuffelhe: Ranger Moss tells of a very soft deer that sometimes comes to look when the old lanterns by the sunbeams of the Sporewood are lit. Light the three lanterns and follow the glowing little hoofprints to the hidden clearing. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_schat_hoedenschat: A hidden treasure of the Chonkdom. It glitters golden yellow when you're close.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_schat_kristalkame: A hidden treasure of the Chonkdom. It glitters golden yellow when you're close.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_schat_schildpad.d: A hidden treasure of the Chonkdom. It glitters golden yellow when you're close.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_schat_slaapheuvel: A hidden treasure of the Chonkdom. It glitters golden yellow when you're close.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_schat_vuurtorenke: A hidden treasure of the Chonkdom. It glitters golden yellow when you're close.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_schat_waterval.de: A hidden treasure of the Chonkdom. It glitters golden yellow when you're close.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_spec17_knuffelrid: You've become a true Snuggle Knight. Reach level 17 and come back to Grandmaster Chonkfoot: then you pick your specialization, Shield Knight or Giant Pillow. After that you're ready for the Shroom Temple. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_spec17_pluisjager: You've become a true Fluff Hunter. Reach level 17 and come back to Grandmaster Chonkfoot: then you pick your specialization, Sharpshooter or Snare Setter. After that you're ready for the Shroom Temple. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_spec17_vadsmagier: You've become a true Chonk Mage. Reach level 17 and come back to Grandmaster Chonkfoot: then you pick your specialization, Star Weaver or Blessing Singer. After that you're ready for the Shroom Temple. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z01_wolletjes.des: The grumpy blobs in the Blob Meadow ate Granny Trudy's balls of yarn. Cheer them up and they'll spit the yarn right back out. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z02_zwamtaart.des: Baker Ben needs shroom caps for his famous shroom pie. The shrooms in the Sporewood drop them once they're happy again. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z03_knuffels.desc: Little Kiki's ten plushies have gone 'on an adventure' and are scattered all over &dthe Chonkdom&r. Find them! They glitter a little when you're close. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z04_inspiratie.de: Poet Percy needs inspiration. Visit three lookout points (the rock spires) and tell him what you saw. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z05_post.desc: Postguh Pete has too many letters. Deliver three of them: to Granny Trudy, Smith Hammerhead and Harbormaster Anchor. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z05_post.title: Mail for Shroomsbury
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z06_tulpen.desc: Ever since the dragon flew over, Gardener Tilly's tulips have been gray. Check out the scar in the Blob Meadow and cheer up ten blobs: maybe that'll help. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z06_tulpen.title: Gray Tulips
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z07_tuba.desc: Musician Mo left his tuba behind at a picnic deep in the Sporewood, by the waterfall in the southwest. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z07_tuba.title: Where's My Tuba?
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z08_pluis.desc: Professor Fluff wants to study gray fluff. Dechonked creatures sometimes drop it when you cheer them up. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z08_pluis.title: Gray Fluff Under the Magnifier
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z09_kristal.desc: Professor Fluff thinks droplet crystals can purify the gray fluff. There's a hidden crystal chamber in the Drip Caves. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z09_kristal.title: Crystal Clear
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z10_rammel.desc: Sir Rattle is retired, but he wants to visit the Blob Meadow one last time. Bring him safely to the first campfire in the meadow. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z10_rammel.title: One Last Adventure
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z11_slijmgel.desc: Stylist Blowdry makes hair gel from fresh blob slime. Happy blobs sometimes drop a droplet. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z12_kleuren.desc: Painter Penny wants to paint the Blob Meadow again, but all the blobs are gray. Cheer up fifteen of them and they'll get their color back. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z12_kleuren.task0: All the Colors of the Meadow
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z12_kleuren.title: All the Colors of the Meadow
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z13_snurk.desc: Sleepyhead Sam can't sleep: every night something in the Blob Meadow snores really loudly. It must be an elite blob. Cheer up an elite. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z13_snurk.title: Who's Snoring There?
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z14_kistjes.desc: Trader Ted's little cart tipped over in the Drip Caves. Four little chests are missing, and the cave creatures have found them. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z14_kistjes.title: Little Chests in the Cave
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z15_lichtjes.desc: Weatherguh Cloudy wants the realm to glow again. Light a campfire in the Blob Meadow, the Sporewood and the Drip Caves. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z16_verstoppertje: Tip is playing hide-and-seek with his twin sister Tap, but he hasn't been able to find her for two days. She's somewhere in the Sporewood. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z17_koning.desc: King Blob lives in the Blob Meadow, the biggest blob in the realm. He's gray and grumpy. Cheer him up, preferably with friends. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z17_koning.title: King Blob
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z18_premie_woud.d: The quest board: a bounty for whoever cheers up twenty-five creatures in the Sporewood. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z19_premie_grotte: The quest board: a bounty for whoever cheers up twenty-five creatures in the Drip Caves. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z20_premie_tempel: The quest board: a bounty for whoever cheers up twenty-five creatures in the Shroom Temple. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z2_aanwijzingen_a: Find all &e5 drill tracks&r in the Splinter Peaks. Where is that machine?
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z2_geheim_boormee: All over the Splinter Peaks lie traces of an enormous Mika machine. Find all five: then you'll know where it is, and how to make its three drill heads overheat. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z2_hq01_splinterp: Grandmaster Chonkfoot saw Wahoognir circling above the crystal spires in the north. Pilotguh Zeppy in the Harbor has a new airship line: to &bSugarbowl&r, the cozy little town in the Splinter Peaks. Fly along and talk to Café Owner Mallow there. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z2_hq02_kandijkom: &bSugarbowl&r lies safe inside its pink geode, but outside the Chonklessness is growing stronger: creatures are turning to gray crystal. Talk to Mayor Candy on the square and report to Captain Quartz of the Crystal Guard. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z2_hq03_galmhelli: East of &bSugarbowl&r lie the Echo Slopes: snowfields with crystal spires that sing back when you touch them. Light Mountain Guide Climbpaw's campfire, talk to him and defeat the crystal creatures roaming around there. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z2_hq04_naalden.d: Mountain Guide Climbpaw wants to know why the crystal spires are singing off-key. Collect echo shards from the creatures on the Echo Slopes and climb to the cracked Echo Spire, where the Echo Wolf howled. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
The Echo Wolf is howling the Chonklessness into the Echo Slopes. Defeat him in his den at the top of the slope. When he howls, crystal waves roll across the snow: hide behind the frozen pillars. But watch out, they break one by one. Then head back to Captain Quartz in &bSugarbowl&r. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z2_hq06_versteend: At the Frozen Snuggle Lake, west of &bSugarbowl&r, four guhs have been turned to gray crystal. Talk to Ice Fisher Holey at his ice hole and free the four guhs: put your paw on the crystal and think of something nice. You never hurt guhs. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z2_hq07_onder_het: Something is moving under the ice of the Snuggle Lake. Defeat the ice creatures around the lake, plus one strong elite, and check out the big crack in the north of the ice. Ice Sculptor Chisel, on the north shore, saw something. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z2_hq08_splinterk: The drag marks lead to the Splinter Gorge, north of &bSugarbowl&r: steep walls, wobbly rope bridges and Mika drill rigs harvesting crystal. Talk to Gorge Keeper Ropey, chase off the Mika miners and find the big drill tower. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z2_hq09_draak.des: Gorge Keeper Ropey saw something big crash down on the mountain pass north of the Frozen Snuggle Lake. Something that breathes. Go take a careful look at what it is. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z2_hq10_spiegelbu: The Mirror Keep stands on the highest peak in the northeast, beyond the Splinter Gorge: a palace of gray crystal full of mirrors. Climb to the gate and talk to Lightkeeper Prism. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z2_hq11_spiegelzu: In the Hall of Mirrors at the back of the Mirror Keep sits Lady Mirrorsigh, turned gray by the splinter of the heart crystal. Go through the mirror corridors to the back: bounce the light from mirror to mirror to open the doors. In the fight she splits into mirror images: you can only hit the image without a shadow, and the light shifts each phase. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z2_hq12_hartsplin: You've found the first splinter of Wahoognir's pink heart crystal. Bring it to Order Master Crystalline, in the Crystal Chapel on the north side of &bSugarbowl&r. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
Free all &e10 plushies&r of Little Flake from under the ice of the Splinter Peaks. They glitter with little hearts.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z2_rijdier_guhwol: At night, Knitter Woolwinter hears something howling in the Splinter Gorge: a little snow wolf, all alone. Find it at the bottom of the gorge, cheer up the grumpy creatures around it and bring it safely to &bSugarbowl&r. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z2_s03_knuffels.d: Little Flake's plushies (knitted by Plushmaker Pip) slid under the ice. They're stuck under the ice of the Frozen Snuggle Lake. They glitter with little hearts: walk up close and you'll carefully break them loose. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
Skate Coach Twirly gives every new adventurer a skating lesson. Step onto the ice of the skating pond and come back without falling. Well. Without falling much. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z2_s05_echokoor.d: Chorister Echo wants to sing with the crystal spires again. Walk past the three singing spires on the Echo Slopes (do, re, mi): when you stand close, they sing their note. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z2_s13_ijsbloemen: Café Owner Mallow always sprinkles ground ice flower over the whipped cream. On the Frozen Snuggle Lake the creatures drop them. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z2_s23_gondel.des: Gondolaguh Cable thinks everyone should ride the gondola to the top at least once. Take the gondola and say hi to Gondolaguh Pulley up top. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z2_schat_burchtda: A hidden treasure of the Splinter Peaks. It glitters golden yellow when you're close.
On the Roof of the Mirror Keep
On the Roof of the Mirror Keep
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z2_schat_chocokel: A hidden treasure of the Splinter Peaks. It glitters golden yellow when you're close.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z2_schat_galmgrot: A hidden treasure of the Splinter Peaks. It glitters golden yellow when you're close.
A hidden treasure of the Splinter Peaks. It glitters golden yellow when you're close.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z2_schat_onder_de: A hidden treasure of the Splinter Peaks. It glitters golden yellow when you're close.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_aanwijzingen_a: Find all &e5 beekeeper clues&r in Honeybough. Who is hiding in the Comb Clusters?
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_adv35_knuffelr: Your second title of the Snuggle Order. Reach class level 35 as a Snuggle Knight and come back to Order Master Waxie in the Nest Chapel: then your specialization grows stronger. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_adv35_pluisjag: Your second title of the Snuggle Order. Reach class level 35 as a Fluff Hunter and come back to Order Master Waxie in the Nest Chapel: then your specialization grows stronger. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_adv35_vadsmagi: Your second title of the Snuggle Order. Reach class level 35 as a Chonk Mage and come back to Order Master Waxie in the Nest Chapel: then your specialization grows stronger. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_geheim_imker.d: All over &6Honeybough&r lie traces of a strange beekeeper: broken smoker pots, gray honey, a beekeeper suit on the clothesline. Find all five and you'll know where he's hiding. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_grauwe_brief.d: Find the first &8Gray Letter&r. Who is writing to the Little Finger?
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_hq01_boom.desc: Order Master Crystalline saw it in the east: a tree as big as a mountain. Captain Polaris in Sugarbowl now flies there: to &6Honeybough&r, a beekeepers' town that hangs like a ring around the trunk of that tree. Beemother Combsy is waiting there. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_hq01_boom.task: A Tree as Big as a Mountain
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_hq01_boom.titl: A Tree as Big as a Mountain
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_hq02_bezoek.de: Order Master Waxie of the Nest Chapel thinks this tree was once Wahoognir's nest. But then a Mika zeppelin buzzes over the market. Defeat the Leaf Bandits it drops on Blossom Square. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_hq03_pluimstal: Stable Master Feathers has three young Plumeguhs. Pick one, give it a name, and take your first ride: Feathers rides ahead of you up the bridle path, round and round the trunk, all the way to the top of canopy 1. Jump off the glide platform there: your first Plume Glide. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_hq04_vlekken.d: Mika zeppelins have sprayed the Canopy Sea gray. Ride past the three gray spots on canopy 1 and canopy 2 and clean them up, defeat the creatures in the canopy and check the Mika Zeppelin Pier to see what they're up to. Canopy Warden Leaf is waiting at his campfire. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_hq05_nest.desc: All the way at the top of the tree, above the three canopy levels, lies a gigantic old nest. Go there and see what's left of it. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_hq06_voetjes.d: The little wooden footprints in the nest belong to the Tree Folk, the old inhabitants of the trunk. Ask Beemother Combsy what she knows. And something is squeaking in the Comb Clusters. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
Mapmaker Loopy lives in Buzzrest Beekeepers' Village, on the Bee Bough in the southeast. Ride up the bridle path and out onto the bough, and help the village: Mika Cheese Shooters have built three outposts on the giant branches. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_hq08_werf.desc: The Cheese Zeppelin Yard lies on an island of its own in the northeast: a Mika shipyard with three docks, each with a half-built cheese zeppelin. Cross the cable bridge, defeat Rigging Master Taleggio, Bombardier Crumble and Captain Roquefort, and search the captain's cabin for the Tree Folk Map. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_hq09_spiraal.d: The Tree Folk Map shows the way inside: the trapdoor at Blossom Square. Behind it, the inner stairs spiral down through the hollow trunk, past the little houses of the Tree Folk in the wall: Barkton. Halfway down there's a little light on the map. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_hq10_piepvel.d: In the middle of Barkton stands the Lantern Tower. Light the seven rings, from bottom to top: on every ring there are little mice in a little cage. Under the floor of Barkton, in the Fur Hall, sits Count Squeakula, the Emperor's Little Finger, in a cape made of little mouse pelts. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_hq11_wortel.de: In Mossfoot, the hamlet at the foot of the tree, the roots are rotting away: the Mikas have put mold kettles in the Root Fields. Talk to Mayor Rootina and shut down the two kettles. The freed little mice will squeak you the way. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_hq12_duister.d: Under the tree lies a great root hall: the Rootdark. With your Nest Lantern, follow the pink veins through the Root Tunnel to the Heartbeat Hall, and light the four cave lanterns at the gate of the Heart, on the far side of the hall. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_hq13_hart.desc: Behind the gate in the west wall, the Heart of the Tree runs like a ring of halls around the root hall. Defeat the Root Strangler, cheer up the Old Nest Warden and defeat Baron Bleu and his Mold Colossus. Then you can reach the Dragon Egg, in the middle of the hall. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_hq14_vahoegnir: Wahoognir is coming for his egg. Escape from the roots and ride up the bridle path, up the wind columns, to the old nest on top of the tree. Put the egg back and cheer up the Chonkless Dragon: at 75, 50 and 25 percent, put a heart splinter back into his chest. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
The dragon is pink again and the egg has hatched. His pink beam pointed east, toward Highchonk, the Floating City. Say goodbye to Beemother Combsy and go back to Order Master Waxie. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
Find all &e10 plushies&r hidden in the Duskroot. Three of them you can only reach by gliding.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_reliefs_alle.d: Find all &e8 reliefs&r of the Tree Folk in the wall of Barkton.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_s01_kuikens.de: Chick Keeper Peep has lost six Plume Chicks in the Canopy Sea. They're hiding by the honey ponds on canopy 1, in pink down. Find them all. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_s02_opa_bast.d: Grandpa Bark wants to see the old nest on top of the tree one last time, like in the old days. He can't walk so well anymore. Take him with you. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_s02_opa_bast.t: One Last Time to the Top
One Last Time to the Top
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_s03_thee.desc: Teaguh Quack in Mossfoot brews honey tea with swamp flowers. It gives you speedy little paws. Pick three swamp flowers in the Root Fields (the creatures in the swamp sometimes drop them). &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_s03_thee.title: Tea in the Swamp
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_s04_lichtjes.d: Along the inner stairs, above &6Honeybough&r, four little lights of the Tree Folk are still asleep. Find them at different heights and wake them up. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_s05_kaartjes.d: Mapmaker Loopy wants to put five lookout points on her new map. But then someone has to have actually stood there. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_schat_moeras.d: A hidden treasure of the Duskroot. It glitters golden yellow when you're close.
A hidden treasure of the Duskroot. It glitters golden yellow when you're close.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_schat_onder_de: A hidden treasure of the Duskroot. It glitters golden yellow when you're close.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_schat_schorsst: A hidden treasure of the Duskroot. It glitters golden yellow when you're close.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z3_schat_worteldu: A hidden treasure of the Duskroot. It glitters golden yellow when you're close.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_flessenpost_al: Find all &e6 messages in a bottle&r on the beaches. Who is writing them?
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_hq01_lampionku: Order Master Waxie got a letter from &dLanternhaven&r, the harbor town on the Lantern Coast. Every year, plushies from all over the world wash ashore there: the Great Snuggletide. But this year they're gray. Fly from the Tree to &dLanternhaven&r and report to Harbormaster Anchor. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_hq02_knuffelti: On Snuggletide Beach, gray, sad plushies lie in the surf. First get your own little sailboat from Boatguh Saily, sail to the beach and ask Washguh Sudsy what's going on. Cheer up six plushies along the tideline and report to Foster Mom Softie. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_hq03_waarvanda: Four big plushies have washed up on other little islands. Sail there, cheer them up and listen to their story. After that, Grandpa Lightbeam in the lighthouse wants to see you: he knows where the current brings them from. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_hq04_mist.desc: All the plushies drift in from the southeast, from the Gray Fog Bank. On the edge of the fog lies Mystery Island. Sail there and take a look at the crumbling gate. A guh who came through the fog is said to live there. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_hq05_vliegerva: A Mika on a big gray war kite stole two pink plushies from the drying line. He's hiding in the Wreck of the Kite Catcher, a stranded Mika kite ship north of Coral Bay. Get the plushies back. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_hq06_feest.des: Foster Mom Softie is throwing a big party on Snuggletide Beach: the twelve plushies are going home, and the refugees are getting a new home. Fetch lanterns, party kites and seashell lemonade, and join the celebration. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_hq07_opstijgpi: Mother Cloudwhale is hanging low over the sea. For the first time in a hundred years, an airship can go up to Highchonk. Sail to the Pierhead in the east and report to Captain Skyhigh at the end of the Liftoff Pier. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
Find all &e8 plushies&r hidden on the Lantern Coast.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_knuffeltij_all: Cheer up all &e12 plushies&r of the Snuggletide: six on the beach, four big ones on the little islands and two from the wreck.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_s01_vlieger.de: Kitemaker Pennant teaches you to build a real guh kite. But the materials have blown away across Kite Island: a stick, a piece of cloth, a roll of string and a tail ribbon. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
Wind Master Swoosh is organizing the great kite contest. Whoever keeps their kite in the wind the longest at the contest pole wins. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_s03_vissen.des: Fisher Bobber wants to know what's biting on the Lantern Coast. Catch five fish with a fishing rod, anywhere you like in the pink sea. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_s04_parels.des: Dive Master Pearl is missing four shiny pearls from her collection. They rolled off the diving pier into the lagoon. Dive them up. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_s05_zeeslurf.d: In the deepest underwater grotto of Coral Bay lies the Gray Sea Snoot: a giant sea cow who has become very sad. Cheer him up. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
Volleyballguh Smash always plays alone. Play a game with him: guess where his ball is going and score three points. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_s07_limonade.d: Lemonadeguh Bubbles needs six pretty little seashells for a new jug of seashell lemonade. They're lying on the beaches of Beach Party Island. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
Grandpa Lightbeam can't make it up the spiral staircase anymore. Climb to the top of the lighthouse and polish the big lens, so the light reaches far again. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_s09_bijen.desc: Five of Beekeeper Nectar's little bees have escaped and are buzzing somewhere among the flowers of Flower Island. Bring them back to the hive. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_s10_kransen.de: Wreathmaker Daisy is weaving flower wreaths for the plushie party. She still needs six flowers from the flower fields. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
Hermit Shelldon lives on the sleeping Granny Bobber; her husband Old Bobber swims circles around her. Old Bobber is hungry: he only likes the tastiest seaweed, and the gray creatures on the coast have it. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_s12_mistbrieve: Lost Misty dropped three little notes on Mystery Island during his escape. They tell of the gray land. He wants them back, so he never forgets where he comes from. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_s13_soep.desc: Soupguh Spoony has four bowls of warm soup ready for the guhs from the east. Bring them around on Snuggletide Beach. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_s13_soep.title: Soup for Everyone
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_s14_lampionnen: Lanternmaker Glowwick wants to hang five new lanterns in &dLanternhaven&r, so the plushies can see the way home. Hang them on the empty hooks. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_s15_strandavon: Partyguh Confetti is throwing a party by the campfire on Beach Party Island. Dance along: stand by the campfire for a while and let your feet do the work. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_s16_flessenpos: Graysie wrote a little note for her granny, who still lives in the east. Throw the message in a bottle into the Ring Current at the edge of the sea: it flows past every coast, even the ones in the east. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
A hidden treasure of the Lantern Coast. It glitters golden yellow when you're close.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_schat_lagune.d: A hidden treasure of the Lantern Coast. It glitters golden yellow when you're close.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_schat_mist.des: A hidden treasure of the Lantern Coast. It glitters golden yellow when you're close.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_schat_vliegert: A hidden treasure of the Lantern Coast. It glitters golden yellow when you're close.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z4_uitzichten_all: Stand on all &e4 lookout points&r of the Lantern Coast.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_adv58_knuffelr: &dHighchonk&r has been saved, Knight. The Cloudwatch wants to give you the highest title of the Snuggle Order. Reach class level 58 as a Snuggle Knight and come back to Captain Springfeather on the training grounds of the Academy. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_adv58_pluisjag: &dHighchonk&r has been saved, Knight. The Cloudwatch wants to give you the highest title of the Snuggle Order. Reach class level 58 as a Fluff Hunter and come back to Captain Springfeather on the training grounds of the Academy. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_adv58_vadsmagi: &dHighchonk&r has been saved, Knight. The Cloudwatch wants to give you the highest title of the Snuggle Order. Reach class level 58 as a Chonk Mage and come back to Captain Springfeather on the training grounds of the Academy. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_grauwe_brief.d: Find the &8Gray Letter&r in the traitor's desk.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_hq01_stad.desc: Mother Cloudwhale has sunk low over the sea. From the Lanternhaven Liftoff Pier, the first airship sails up: to &dHighchonk&r, the capital of all guhs, on the whale's back. Queen Gentleheart is waiting for you. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_hq02_verraad.d: The Torn Page has been stolen from the Council Hall: the oldest story of the Order. There's a traitor on the High Council. Inspector Snoop helps you sniff around. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_hq03_mol.desc: Someone left the back door of the Council Hall open. Captain Springfeather thinks there's a mole in the Cloudwatch. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_hq03_mol.title: The Mole in the Cloudwatch
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_hq04_soep.desc: The command notes turned up under a soup bowl in the Great Soup Kitchen. That's where the Unchonked eat, the skinny refugees from the east. Anyone sneaking around there at night gets seen. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_hq05_logboek.d: A traitor has to take his secrets somewhere. The Skyport is the only way off the whale. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
Two council members left. General Downfeather was nowhere to be found at night. Chancellor Softpelt has the seal of the Chancellery. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_hq07_bewijsbor: All the clues have been found. Lay them side by side on the evidence board, and point out the traitor. In front of the whole High Council. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_hq08_wolkwaldr: Pinkie Silvertail jumped into the middle blowhole with the Torn Page, deep into the whale. In there he sings the lullaby backwards. Mother Cloudwhale is dreaming gray, and she's sinking. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_hq09_slaaplied: The lullaby is on the back of the page. Sing it the right way around, by Mother Cloudwhale's eye, and she'll wake right up. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_hq10_stormrand: Silvertail was working for the Ring Finger, a general of the Emperor. There's still mail in his Chancellery. And in the east, beyond the Cloud Sea, the stars are going out. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
Find all &e8 plushies&r hidden in Highchonk.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_s01_bessen.des: The kettle of the Great Soup Kitchen never runs empty, but the cloudberries do. They grow in Tail Park and the Eye Garden. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_s02_flap.desc: Fluffy has lost her plushie bunny Flop. She was in the cathedral to look at the light. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_s02_flap.title: Fluffy's Plushie
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_s03_brieven.de: Grandpa Graywhisker writes letters every day. They need to go to the right guhs in &dHighchonk&r: they can send them on. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_s04_oog.desc: Professor Specsworth wants to know how big the second moon, the Eye, looks in the sky. You can measure it from the observatory. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_s04_oog.title: Measuring the Eye
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_s05_adem.desc: Mother Cloudwhale breathes through three blowholes. Professor Specsworth wants to know if she is still breathing healthily. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_s05_adem.title: Mother Cloudwhale's Breath
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_s06_parcours.d: Every Cloudwatch cadet runs the Cloud Course: four posts on the training square. Captain Springfeather wants to see if you can do it. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_s07_kadet.desc: Cadet Down is lost again. He is standing on a pier of the Skyport. Bring him back to the Academy. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_s08_markt.desc: The market of &dHighchonk&r is bustling. Stallguh Lindy has parcels for three other stalls. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_s09_bloesem.de: The blossom trees in Tail Park are thirsty. Gardenguh Sprig has one watering can and four trees. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_s10_wol.desc: Three balls of pink wool have rolled out of the Queen's knitted crown. Court Lady Needles wants them back before the Queen notices. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_s10_wol.title: The Woolen Crown
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_s11_knuffellie: Every evening in the Order Cathedral they sing the song of the First Snuggle. Sister Softsong wants you to see the light the way the first knights saw it. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
The Song of the First Snuggle
The Song of the First Snuggle
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_schat_ooggaard: A hidden treasure of Highchonk. It glitters golden yellow when you are close.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_schat_staartvi: A hidden treasure of Highchonk. It glitters golden yellow when you are close.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_schat_troonzaa: A hidden treasure of Highchonk. It glitters golden yellow when you are close.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z5_uitkijken_alle: Discover all &e4 lookout points&r of Highchonk.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z6_bakens_alle.de: Light all &e5 star beacons&r of the Silklands again.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z6_grauwe_brief.d: Find the &8Gray Letter&r in the Mika camp on the Salt Flats.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z6_hq01_land.desc: Mother Cloudwhale swims all of Highchonk east, until the pink cliffs of the Great Mainland loom up. That's where the &dSilklands&r lie. Line E flies from Highchonk Tail Harbor to Rose Gorge Skyport. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
Granny Date is setting off with her little caravan to Saffron Gate, even though the star beacons are out. She could use an extra pair of paws. And you could use a humpguh. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z6_hq03_duinen.de: Granny Date's caravan travels up through the Siq and along the Pink Dunes to Saffron Gate. Without beacons. Stay close. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z6_hq04_sultane.d: Sultana Raisin keeps the old star map of the &dSilklands&r. Grand Vizier Cinnamon Stick arranges the audience. And Stargazer Twinkle can teach you how to read the stars. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z6_hq05_palmbaken: The first beacon stands above the waterfalls of the Palm Gorges. At night you have to follow the constellation The Date Palm, or it won't flare up. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z6_hq06_tapijt.de: With silk cocoons from the mulberry trees and stardust from the Palm Beacon, Carpet Weaver Button can weave a flying carpet. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z6_hq07_zoutvlakt: Granny Date's caravan is camping on the Salt Flats. That's where the Salt Beacon is, and something big is sleeping under the salt. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z6_hq08_sterrenwa: In Ruin Valley lies The Sunken Observatory of the old Star Guhs. Inside: the Star Compass, which knows the way to the Ruin Beacon and to the oasis. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z6_hq09_spiegelza: In the Hall of Mirrors, a thousand mirrors bounce the light of the beacons around. With the Star Compass, they reveal the hidden path to the Mother Oasis. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z6_hq10_moederoas: The great caravan travels by night along the star path to the Mother Oasis. Light the Dune Beacon and the Oasis Beacon, find Mother Spring and look the Ring Finger's tower in the eye. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
Find all &e8 plushies&r hidden in the Silklands.
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z6_ringeling.desc: Cheer up &dDuchess Ringaling&r, at the top of The Star-Snuffing Tower (raid).
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z6_s01_verjaardag: Lumpkin, Granny Date's baby humpguh, is having a birthday. There has to be a date cake. And a party. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z6_s02_tuinen.des: The hanging gardens of Rose Gorge hang over three ledges. They're thirsty, and the wall stairs are steep. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z6_s03_post.desc: Postguh Stamp has six letters for rock houses on different ledges. Her little paws are tired. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z6_s03_post.title: Mail in the Rock
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z6_s04_kwastjes.d: Carpet Weaver Button's tassels have blown away all over Saffron Gate: onto roofs, into the bazaar and along the canal. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z6_s05_afdingen.d: In the Grand Bazaar, haggling is part of the deal. But whoever haggles sweetly gets the biggest discount. Try it with three merchants. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z6_s06_norias.des: The three big water wheels of Saffron Gate don't creak anymore. They're standing still. Millguh Creak can feel it in his teeth. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z6_s07_eendjes.de: Little Pip's ten rubber ducks have floated away through the little canals of the Canal Quarter. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z6_s07_eendjes.ta: Rubber Ducks in the Canal Quarter
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z6_s07_eendjes.ti: Rubber Ducks in the Canal Quarter
ftb.guhs_vadsrijk.q.vr_z6_s08_examen.des: Twinkle wants to know if you're a real stargazer. Four constellations, four high places. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
A gang of date monkeys has nicked Datepit's date harvest and hidden it in the palms. &7(Checks itself off once you hand it in inside the Chonkdom.)
